spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    start_time AS "time",
    pkt_srcaddr AS "metric",
    SUM(bytes) AS "value"
FROM vpc_flow_logs_10min
WHERE pkt_srcaddr LIKE '10.95.30.%'
  AND start_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
SAMPLE BY 1s
FILL(0)
ORDER BY 1;
